'''August 2000 San Francisco tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in BallPark, San Francisco, CA on 5 August 2000. [[Alfred Dong]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1095">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-san-francisco-ca-9-5d1095/ san-francisco-ca-9-5], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 7 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-san-francisco-ca-9-5d1095/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 August 2000
* '''Site:''' BallPark, San Francisco, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
